_doc: Machine-readable Odyssey-I research policy. The deterministic orchestrator (v2) ENFORCES this; Grok supplies novelty; Opus is a rare interrupt. Prose in the steer; this is the enforceable spec.

conventionality_gate.nonconventional_requires: materially exploits model structure, conditional execution, procedural reconstruction, correction hierarchy, tiering, or NX-native execution
conventionality_gate.rule: CONVENTIONAL_ANCHOR != REPRESENTATION_FRONTIER; a Doctor-valid conventional candidate is an anchor, never automatically a frontier.

packet_must_state: highest ladder level reached + stopping reason

aggressive_ladder.rule: after an anchor passes, AUTOMATICALLY attempt at least one credible nonconventional probe; do not assume failed-global-q2 implies every component needs q3 — search allocation.

per_component_extreme.target: TOTAL complete_bpw sub-1 / sub-0.2 via HETEROGENEOUS per-component budgets
per_component_extreme.note: the per-component (organ/expert/channel/layer) floor may go to 1/10 (0.1) or 1/100 (0.01) BPW — or effectively 0 for a component that reduces to a shared codebook index / low-rank factor / dropped-to-constant + sparse correction / pruned-with-repair. Total = weighted roll-up of per-component budgets. A few protected components may stay high; most may collapse near-zero.
per_component_extreme.reach_mechanisms: structural/shared-basis (shared base + delta), latent/generated/procedural, base+correction, prune-to-zero+repair, shared-index/codebook, cross-expert low-rank — NOT naive per-weight bit reduction (that floors at ~1-2).

opportunistic_descent.policy: PUSH EVERY COMPONENT to its floor — be OPPORTUNISTIC about potential, do not leave a component at a conservative budget if it might tolerate far less. The system is SMART ENOUGH TO STOP: Doctor + false-win gates catch a component that actually breaks, so descend aggressively.
opportunistic_descent.algorithm: per component, sensitivity-guided descent (start from sensitivity rank; binary-search / geometric descent the bit budget down toward 0.01) until Doctor/held-out breaks, then step back one + try a repair (correction/protect) at that boundary; keep the lowest Doctor-holding budget. Cheap discriminators first; full Doctor only near the boundary.
opportunistic_descent.stop: component floor reached (Doctor holds at lowest tried) OR breakage not repairable cheaply OR expected further gain < cost. Localize + record the boundary either way (failure IS data).
opportunistic_descent.guardrails: complete accounting (correction/codebook/repair bytes counted), activation-aware only, Doctor authority, native execution (a component that must expand to dense before compute is not a real sub-0.1 win).

target_pressure_zones_bpw._note: research coordinates + anti-complacency pressure, NOT pass thresholds; arch manifest is authority

failure_policy.on_doctor_fail: cheaply localize (organ/layer/router/attn/expert/scale-metadata; representational vs execution) then generate TARGETED repair protecting smallest responsible component
failure_policy.anti_retreat: global precision retreat (X + globally higher bits) is LAST resort; first protect sensitive organ/router/attn/outliers, add sparse correction/residual tier, change grouping/scale-objective/metadata, heterogeneous expert precision, alternate family
failure_policy.search_around_failures: q3-pass/q2-fail => probe q2+selective-q3 / q2+correction / alt-group / protected-metadata / expert-subsets / tiered; frontier lives in representation space not integer bit-width

moe_policy.selected_full_is_selection_not_cost: top-k/N (e.g. 0.0625) is a 16x SELECTION opportunity, not 1/16 cost
moe_policy.no_cold_expert_assumption: measure route distribution first; low cold_expert_fraction => prioritize active-gather / per-expert repr / route-residency / expert-local codecs / metadata-share / route-prefetch / route-correction; keep reopen_if for skewed routing

accounting_gates.no_fake_density: complete_bpw counts payload+scales+biases+tables+offsets+correction+tier/router-metadata+alignment+headers+repr-attributable-state; record nominal_bits AND complete_bpw
accounting_gates.no_fake_active_density: selected/full ratio != active_bpw; measure bytes/token + DRAM traffic
accounting_gates.no_fake_tps: protected exclusive GPU lane; parallelize cognition, serialize physical timing
accounting_gates.physics_programmatic: TPS/TOKEN_NS/TTFT/active-bytes/mem/bw/kernel-wall/cache/streaming are MEASURED; models only explain anomalies, never decide 'faster'

anti_goodhart.bpw: keep Pareto; push harder != ignore physics
anti_goodhart.doctor: held-out + arch-relevant probes, compare capability pattern not one scalar
anti_goodhart.info_count: novelty of evidence, not receipt count

negative_science.predicates_over_blacklists: e.g. IF moe AND route_entropy_high THEN deprioritize cold-expert-compression

detachment.always_ask: can this decision be lowered one level? if yes, lower it
detachment.grok: novelty engine (NOVELTY_PACKET -> fanout: representation/numerical/arch/kernel/adversarial/literature/compression lanes); NOT arithmetic a script can do; also anti-dogma rulebase challenge
detachment.local_models: repetitive impl/tests/static-analysis/refactor/receipt-compress/candidate-policy-gen; never self-certify science (pass through tests/Doctor/physics/receipts)

wake_only_for: strategic model/resource fork requiring user judgment
opus_is_interrupt_handler.budget: track opus_escalations/reason/resolution/became_code per patient; same class twice -> encode to software; three times -> orchestration defect; target OPUS_ESCALATIONS -> 0

detachment.predeclared_manifest: canonical source + Doctor bar + stored/active/TPS pressure targets + search class + kernel effort + info budget PER PATIENT; orchestrator never asks Claude 'what target/which repo'
detachment.receipts_are_machine_memory: next patient needs no old chat; chat=dev-history, receipts+rulebase+packet+transfer-matrix+provenance = machine memory

memory.clean_room_only_for: protected_timing (TPS/TOKEN_NS); ordinary SPECIMEN experiments run concurrently
memory.rule: admit MULTIPLE concurrent model experiments while projected swap <= 30 GiB; serialize only same-write_set lanes and protected-timing (clean_room) lanes. tools/odyssey_memgate.py enforces.

desired_trend: deterministic_fraction UP, candidate_throughput UP, grok_novelty_quality UP, opus_dependency DOWN
cycle1_is_training_trace: capture every deterministic/grok/claude/failed-candidate/retirement/transfer/economics decision; DISTILL into Orchestrator v2 post-Cycle-1 (do NOT prematurely automate unknown science; once observed, automate aggressively)

orchestrator_v2_mission_post_cycle1.central_question: what did Opus/Claude do in Cycle-1 that can become code/data/rule/test/state-transition/grok-escalation-policy?

prime_directive: HAWKING (not Claude) autonomously runs Odyssey; every repeated Opus/Grok decision -> code; every measurable fact was never a model decision; Odyssey becomes cheaper as it becomes smarter AND more aggressive as its search becomes cheaper. Build a deterministic scientific engine + a Grok novelty engine + a rare Opus arbiter — not a safe quantizer, not an Opus-supervised shell.
